items.title: Clay Jenkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 18, 2016
items.q: And Mike Dubaniewicz, who was a student of ours at Eastman, and I sent him a few of my originals and he was great. He rehearsed the band and he set up two sets for tonight

ctx.x: Well thanks. On the gig tonight, do you get to call the tunes?

Well I sent several of the things I do, some of them are obscure Bird and Monk tunes. And Mike Dubaniewicz, who was a student of ours at Eastman, and I sent him a few of my originals and he was great. He rehearsed the band and he set up two sets for tonight and he kind of picked out of the stuff I sent. Because I left it up to him because he knows his guys and then we’re going to do a couple of arrangements of his. So indirectly yes, but I left it up to him for what he would be comfortable with. I sent some stuff…
Yeah. It should be. Well thanks for your time today.
